author: The Current
description:
Singer-songwriter Ryan Bingham talks about how he connected with the band The Texas Gentlemen
Support The Current: https://support.mpr.org/youtube or hit the Thanks button

When singer-songwriter Ryan Bingham was in Minnesota on October 23 to play at the Palace Theatre in St. Paul, he visited The Current earlier in the day for an interview with host Zach McCormick, where Bingham described how fortuitous it’s been that he’s connected with the Texas Gentlemen. They’ve become far more than a touring band. “It’s just a really fun, unique group, and they’re so creative and inspiring to play music with."

Hear more from Ryan Bingham about the Texas Gentlemen — including the band’s full lineup — in the video above.

description:
Low Cut Connie's Adam Weiner describes the experience of performing on "Jimmy Kimmel Live!"
Support The Current: https://support.mpr.org/youtube or hit the Thanks button

The year 2026 was a big one for Low Cut Connie. In addition to a big album release and tour, Low Cut Connie also got to perform on the late-night TV series, “Jimmy Kimmel Live!” 

In an interview with The Current’s Jill Riley, Low Cut Connie’s Adam Weiner recounts what it was like to perform on “Kimmel,” and how that event turned into a special celebration. Hear Adam’s story in the video above.
